issues.description: GET collection endpoint path for listing Person resources is inconsistent across artifacts: the template PersonResource defines the endpoint with @GetMapping("persons") while the solution PersonResource defines it with @GetMapping("people"). The problem statement and the integration tests use the path "/persons" for related endpoints (e.g., POST /persons, PUT /persons/{personId}/parents). This mismatch can cause tests or client calls that expect /persons to fail against the solution implementation and will confuse students which path to implement or use.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single consistent path for the collection GET endpoint across template, solution, tests and problem statement. Prefer aligning the solution to the problem statement and tests by changing the solution's @GetMapping("people") to @GetMapping("persons"). Alternatively, update the problem statement and tests to use "people" if that naming is intentional — but ensure all artifacts match.
